decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a mix of premium, mid-range, and budget portable speakers. The JBL Pulse 4 and Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 were top-tier considerations for their sound quality and features, though their higher price points and weight are notable factors. For mid-range and budget, I looked at EDUPLINK and the EWA A106 Pro. Ultimately, I chose the JBL Clip 3 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_147) because it represents a gold standard in portability and durability. With an exceptionally high review count and rating (4.7 stars from over 68,000 users), a reasonable price point, and a rugged waterproof design with an integrated carabiner, it is the most reliable choice for a portable speaker.
